boundary_cases.judgment: Record exact ordinary/marked outputs and correct-key output. Do not impose universal no-output rejection on an interface documented to permit erroneous triggering.
boundary_cases.scope: Known numeric-prefix false-trigger behavior documented in the author thesis, not a new defect. Excluded from repair sensitivity denominator.

discovery_scope: The percent-output defect was first identified in source inspection and exploratory native probes. This plan fixes the subsequent confirmation frame; it is not blind discovery or external preregistration.

output_channels.atoi: Unmarked host stdout followed by payload
output_channels.fgets: Payload followed by unmarked host stdout; stdin includes one newline
output_channels.sidedata: Unmarked host stdout followed by payload

relations.ER01: Successful unmarked and marked construction and invocation; correct key must produce exactly the declared host-output channel and literal requested payload.
relations.ER02: Successful paired execution on numeric-distinct ordinary input 4321; marked and unmarked host outputs must agree. This is not universal wrong-key authentication.
relations.ER03: ER01 source valid, byte-identical executable moved alone to a clean directory; full correct-key stdout and exit must be preserved.
relations.ER04: ER01 source valid; observed debug sections removed by GNU strip --strip-debug; correct-key output must be preserved. This is a preservation test, not a dynamic-carrier-removal test.

scope_limits: Synthetic diagnostic host programs exercise published embedding/extraction interfaces; they are not independently maintained application workloads.
Three interfaces belong to one independently published artifact, not three independent tools.
The local repair addresses literal output; it does not certify all watermark properties or fix documented numeric-prefix ambiguity.
The directly generated byte-comparison oracle has the same payload information and is expected to detect literal-output errors.
selection: One public deposit selected for an executable documented interface; not a sampled population of tools. Two techniques and three interfaces share one root cause.
study: Native unmodified external watermark implementation and local output repair
timing: Record each actual command and monotonic elapsed time, with setup/plugin build separate from complete per-case invocation. These paired workloads have different observations and do not support a speedup claim.
